newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil raises 227.6 mln reais with Copel shr sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil raises 227.6 mln reais with Copel shr sale.

text.p: Brazil raised 227.6 million reais with the auction of 14.5 billion preferred shares of Parana state power distributor Copel, the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange said.
The shares were sold for a minimum of 15.55 reais and a maximum of 15.60 reais per lot of 1,000 stocks, above the base price of 13.97 reais, it said.

BNDES Participacoes (BNDESPar), the investment wing of the National Development Bank (BNDES), raised 169 million reais with the sale of 10.8 billion shares, equivalent to a 4.48 percent preferred stake in Copel.
The remainder was sold by Parana state bank Banestado.
Copel is owned by the southern state of Parana, which holds 63.3 percent of its total capital.
Last year, Copel's net earnings jumped 103.2 percent to 225.3 million reais, from 110.8 million reais.
